scope: 70 new regional tasks; the four pre-existing supplementation tasks are excluded
unknown_publication_date: Empty source_date; never substitute access date. confidence=low.
unknown_season: Empty season accepted only with confidence=low and explanatory freq_note; all requires evidence of year-round operation.
marine_services: Encoded as river/ferry under the requested mode vocabulary; actual maritime nature is explained in notes.
settlement_matching: Exact input IDs and names; ext: only for destinations outside the region. Unmatched locations and within-settlement crossings are documented in regional notes.
remoteness: Statutory medical/tax/electoral categories retain their specific purpose and historical edition; they do not establish absence of roads.
availability: Some records are historical, partial or undated. Do not treat the whole corpus as a verified current transport network. Read period, confidence, freq_note and regional note before routing.
source_audit: Structural checks cover all output files; independent source checks cover a sample, not every link.
